annotation.authors_or_issuer: 農林水産省・経済産業省・国土交通省 (MAFF, METI, MLIT)
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets facility criteria for specific distribution facilities under the Act on Efficiency of Distribution of Goods, including location near highways, ports and rail freight stations.
Warehouse criteria list automated guided vehicles, automated storage devices and industrial robots for handling as qualifying efficiency equipment.
Sets application contents and documents for approval of comprehensive efficiency plans and their changes.
Sets a five-year validity period for facility confirmation.
Routes applications through regional bureaus or prefectural governors.
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance implementing the Act on Efficiency of Distribution of Goods. It sets criteria for specific distribution facilities, application procedures for plan approval, and a five-year facility confirmation period. Warehouse criteria list AGVs, automated storage and industrial robots as qualifying equipment; no AI governance content.
annotation.title_clean: 物資の流通の効率化に関する法律施行規則
annotation.title_en: Ordinance for Enforcement of the Act on Efficiency of Distribution of Goods
